prompt:
## Was It a Full Democracy?

Assemblies advised kings, a verse praised thinking together, and the Saṁgha voted.

**Predict:** Was ancient India a full democracy, in the way we use the word today?

options.text: Yes. It had assemblies and voting, so it worked just as India works today.
No. Nothing in ancient India was like a democratic practice at all.
In part. It had consultation and voting, but not every adult had a vote.
